items.detail_en:

The total sample was 807 U.S. marketing, service and CX practitioners; headline analysis used the 536-person live-use subgroup.

The online survey ran September 8–23; results are self-reported and were not independently audited.

The report proposes five measurement disciplines: outcome, owner, baseline, comparison and review.

Satisfaction and quantified evidence are different signals. Teams can define baselines, owners and comparison methods before treating positive perceptions as demonstrated ROI.
